name: CBC-Commercial-Estimating-Ontology
description: OKF ontology for CBC commercial estimating: brand programmes, hardware set templates, throat derivations, vendor substitutions, and patterns learned from estimator corrections. Validated on load by cbc_engine.okf.OKFKnowledgeGraph.validate().
invariants: No node carries a price. CatalogProduct holds identity and pricing basis only; list_price, net_cost, price and cost are rejected by validate(). Prices are looked up from catalog-intelligence at quote time so they can be verified against the current price book.
Node-level certainty is always the field `confidence` (0.0-1.0). There is no `confidence_score`.
Every edge's source and target must resolve to an existing node.

BrandAccount.description: National account or chain brand client with a standardized hardware and margin programme
BrandAccount.notes: Only Wendy's programme margins are CBC-confirmed (requirements 6.1). Any other brand carries margin_status 'PENDING_CBC_DATA' (NR-9), and get_brand_intelligence returns the standard bands rather than inventing a rate.

HardwareSetTemplate.description: A CBC reference hardware grouping. The spec's own hardware schedule outranks it (requirements 7.7).

CatalogProduct.description: Vendor product identity and pricing basis. NEVER a price.

WallTypeMapping.description: Architectural wall description mapped to a hollow metal frame throat depth

VendorEquivalence.description: A substitution between a specified product and one CBC stocks. Always requires GC approval when quoted.

EstimatorCorrectionPattern.description: A rule learned from a human estimator override in memory/corrections.jsonl
EstimatorCorrectionPattern.notes: confidence_weight starts at 0.6 and rises by 0.1 each time the same override is applied again. One override is evidence, not law.

UncarriedDivisionPattern.description: A CSI division no vendor on the shelf covers, requiring an outside RFQ
UncarriedDivisionPattern.notes: Do not name a recommended outside vendor. Scranton was removed at CBC's instruction (requirements 2.2 — access lost).

PREFERS_THROAT.notes: A brand programme's standard wall build (McDonald's 5-5/8"). Previously mistyped as PREFERS_HARDWARE_SET pointing at a WallTypeMapping.
